external.description: Apple has unveiled the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone and the biggest update to the iPhone lineup in nearly 20 years. The device combines a compact outer screen with a large inner display that becomes available when the body is unfolded. As highlighted by CNN Sales of the iPhone Duo will begin on October 23. The smartphone starts at $1,999. The model features cameras on the rear and front panels, as well as an additional camera inside the body. The iPhone Duo will redefine the foldable phone experience. – John Ternus, Apple CEO When folded, the smartphone is similar in shape and size to a passport. Once unfolded, Apple calls it the thinnest iPhone in the company’s history. The outer display measures 5.4 inches diagonally, while the inner display measures 7.6 inches – roughly the size of an iPad mini. iPhone Duo design and displays The inner screen has a matte finish. It is designed to reduce glare and help the surface remain free of noticeable fingerprints for longer. The crease is barely visible, and it is difficult to feel when running a finger across the display. This sets the iPhone Duo apart from early foldable smartphones from Samsung...
